stumbles.quote: it names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained, and it's unclear what the `github` tool is or how it is called.
Unclear what kind of session this means (an agent session, a shell session, or something else) and who runs it.
The text doesn't say why these calls would get a 403. The reader can't tell whether the guard is meant to stop a known permission problem.

point: The commit extends the guard script so that `gh api` POST calls to paths ending in `/releases` or `/git/refs` are denied, as `gh release create` already was, because a session got past the guard that way and received a 403.
